资料.en: The information you gave me is of little use.
资料.es: La información que me diste no me es de ayuda.

资料.zh: 你确定你的资料属实吗？
资料.pinyin: Nǐ què dìng nǐ de zī liào shǔ shí ma
资料.en: Are you sure of your facts?

资料.zh: 你可以帮我更新这份资料吗？
资料.pinyin: Nǐ kě yǐ bāng wǒ gēng xīn zhè fèn zī liào ma
资料.en: Could I get you to update this data for me?

资料.zh: 你要先输入好个人资料，然后才能买票。
资料.pinyin: Nǐ yào xiān shū rù hǎo gè rén zī liào rán hòu cái néng mǎi piào
资料.en: To purchase a ticket, you need to enter your personal details.
资料.es: Para comprar una entrada, hay que entrar tus detalles personales.

银.zh: 金窝银窝不如自己的狗窝。
银.pinyin: Jīn wō yín wō bù rú zì jǐ de gǒu wō
银.en: There is no place like home.
银.es: No hay nada como el hogar.

银.pinyin: Nǐ néng fēn biàn yín hé xī ma
银.en: Can you tell silver and tin apart?

银.pinyin: Tóng hé yín dōu shì jīn shǔ
银.en: Copper and silver are both metals.
银.es: El cobre y la plata son dos metales.

银.pinyin: Měi duǒ yún dōu pī zhe yín yī
银.en: Every cloud has a silver lining.
银.es: No hay mal que por bien no venga.

角色.zh: 大自然在我们的生活中扮演着重要的角色。
角色.pinyin: Dà zì rán zài wǒ men de shēng huó zhōng bàn yǎn zhuó zhòng yào de jué sè
角色.en: Nature plays an important role in our life.
角色.es: La naturaleza juega un papel importante en nuestra vida.

角色.zh: 他在剧中演了一个小角色。
角色.pinyin: Tā zài jù zhōng yǎn le yī ge xiǎo jué sè
角色.en: He played a minor part in the play.
角色.es: Él interpretó un rol menor en la obra.

角色.zh: 你最喜欢这本书中的哪个角色？
角色.pinyin: Nǐ zuì xǐ huan zhè běn shū zhòng dì nǎ ge jué sè
角色.en: Who's your favorite character in this book?
角色.es: ¿Cuál personaje de este libro es tu favorito?

角色.zh: 巫术在原始社会扮演重要角色。
角色.pinyin: Wū shù zài yuán shǐ shè huì bàn yǎn zhòng yào jué sè
角色.en: Magic plays an important part in primitive society.
角色.es: La magia juega un papel importante en las sociedades primitivas.

悲观.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu gǎn dào bēi guān
Wǒ shí ér lè guān shí ér bēi guān
悲观.en: I am by turns an optimist and a pessimist.

悲观.pinyin: Bù yào gǎn jué nà me bēi guān

建设.zh: 一座新的教学楼正在建设。
建设.pinyin: Yī zuò xīn de jiào xué lóu zhèng zài jiàn shè
建设.en: A new school building is under construction.
建设.es: Se está construyendo una nueva escuela.

建设.zh: 批评的目的是建设而不是破坏。
建设.pinyin: Pī píng de mù dì shì jiàn shè ér bù shì pò huài
建设.en: The purpose of criticism is to construct, not to destroy.

建设.zh: 这里正在筹划建设一座发电站。
建设.pinyin: Zhè lǐ zhèng zài chóu huà jiàn shè yī zuò fā diàn zhàn
建设.en: Plans are being drawn up to build a power station here.

建设.zh: 政府应该彻底加强军队建设！
建设.pinyin: Zhèng fǔ yīng gāi chè dǐ jiā qiáng jūn duì jiàn shè
建设.en: The government should strengthen their army once and for all!

扶.zh: 你看都出血了，我扶你起来吧。
扶.pinyin: Nǐ kàn dōu chū xuè le wǒ fú nǐ qǐ lai ba
扶.en: You're bleeding everywhere; I'll help you up.
扶.es: Estás sangrando por todos lados; te ayudaré.

扶.zh: 他将一位老太太从位子上扶起来。
扶.pinyin: Tā jiāng yī wèi lǎo tài tai cóng wèi zi shàng fú qǐ lai
扶.en: He helped an old lady get up from her seat.

壶.pinyin: Hú lǐ miàn méi yǒu shā táng le
壶.en: There is no sugar left in the pot.
壶.es: No hay más azúcar en el pote.

壶.zh: 你要喝什么茶？泡壶柠檬红茶好吧？
壶.pinyin: Nǐ yào hē shén me chá pāo hú níng méng hóng chá hǎo ba
壶.en: What tea do you drink? Is lemon tea okay?
壶.es: ¿Qué té tomas? ¿Té de limón está bien?

壶.zh: 鲍伯把这个壶装满了水。
壶.pinyin: Bào bǎi bǎ zhè ge hú zhuāng mǎn le shuǐ
壶.en: Bob filled the pot with water.

老百姓.zh: 许多老百姓加入了军队。
老百姓.pinyin: Xǔ duō lǎo bǎi xìng jiā rù le jūn duì
老百姓.en: A great number of citizens went into the army.
老百姓.es: Un gran número de ciudadanos ingresaron al ejército.

老百姓.zh: 自古至今，容忍的总是老百姓，被容忍的总是统治者。
老百姓.pinyin: Zì gǔ zhì jīn róng rěn de zǒng shì lǎo bǎi xìng bèi róng rěn de zǒng shì tǒng zhì zhě
老百姓.en: Since ancient times, it has always been the commoners who tolerate their ruler.

声调.pinyin: Tā shēng diào tū rán biàn le
声调.en: There was a sudden change in her tone.

声调.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ yīn yuè shēng diào xiǎo
声调.en: Please lower the volume of the music!

运输.zh: 这辆卡车从青森运输新鲜食品到东京。
运输.pinyin: Zhè liàng kǎ chē cóng qīng sēn yùn shū xīn xiān shí pǐn dào dōng jīng
运输.en: This truck transports fresh food from Aomori to Tokyo.
运输.es: Este camión transporta alimentos frescos de Aomori a Tokio.

运输.pinyin: Shí yóu bèi yóu chuán yùn shū
运输.es: El petróleo es transportado en buques petroleros.

运输.zh: 这个电子仪器肯定在运输途中损坏了。
运输.pinyin: Zhè ge diàn zǐ yí qì kěn dìng zài yùn shū tú zhōng sǔn huài le
运输.en: This electrical device must have been damaged during delivery.

灰心.zh: 他很坚强，不会那么容易灰心。
灰心.pinyin: Tā hěn jiān qiáng bù huì nà me róng yì huī xīn
灰心.en: He won't be easily discouraged, because he's a tough guy.
灰心.es: Él no se desalentará con facilidad, porque es un tipo duro.

惊讶.zh: 我们听到所发生的事，感到很惊讶。
惊讶.pinyin: Wǒ men tīng dào suǒ fā shēng de shì gǎn dào hěn jīng yà
惊讶.en: We were astonished to hear what had happened.
惊讶.es: Nos sorprendió escuchar lo que había pasado.

惊讶.zh: 你会很惊讶你在一周内能学到多少东西。
惊讶.pinyin: Nǐ huì hěn jīng yà nǐ zài yī zhōu nèi néng xué dào duō shao dōng xi
惊讶.en: You'd be surprised what you can learn in a week.
惊讶.es: Te sorprendería lo que puedes aprender en una semana.

惊讶.zh: 感到惊讶、感到惊奇就是明白的开始。
惊讶.pinyin: Gǎn dào jīng yà gǎn dào jīng qí jiù shì míng bai de kāi shǐ
惊讶.en: To be surprised, to wonder, is to begin to understand.
惊讶.es: Sorprenderse, extrañarse, es comenzar a entender.

惊讶.zh: 整个小区对这个消息很惊讶。
惊讶.pinyin: Zhěng gè xiǎo qū duì zhè ge xiāo xi hěn jīng yà
惊讶.en: The whole neighborhood was surprised at the news.
惊讶.es: El vecindario entero se sorprendió por la noticia.

爆炸.pinyin: Wǒ men tīng dào zhà dàn bào zhà le
爆炸.en: We heard the bomb go off.

爆炸.pinyin: Bào zhà de yuán yīn shì shén me
爆炸.en: What was the cause of the explosion?
爆炸.es: ¿Cuál fue la causa de la explosión?

爆炸.zh: 炸弹爆炸的时候，我刚好就在现场。
爆炸.pinyin: Zhà dàn bào zhà de shí hou wǒ gāng hǎo jiù zài xiàn chǎng
爆炸.en: When the bomb exploded, I happened to be there.
爆炸.es: De casualidad yo estaba ahí cuando la bomba estalló.

爆炸.zh: 他们趁炸弹还没有爆炸的时候就把它拆掉了。
爆炸.pinyin: Tā men chèn zhà dàn hái méi yǒu bào zhà de shí hou jiù bǎ tā chāi diào le
爆炸.en: They defused the bomb before it could blow up.
爆炸.es: Desmantelaron la bomba antes de que pudiera estallar.

武器.pinyin: Fàng xià nǐ men de wǔ qì
Zhè shì yī zhǒng wǔ qì

武器.zh: 他用他的雨伞当作武器。
武器.pinyin: Tā yòng tā de yǔ sǎn dàng zuò wǔ qì
武器.en: He used his umbrella as a weapon.
武器.es: Él usó su paraguas como un arma.

武器.pinyin: Xié dài wǔ qì shì wéi fǎ de
武器.en: It's against the law to carry weapons.

拼命.zh: 他为了孩子的幸福，拼命的工作。
拼命.pinyin: Tā wèi le hái zi de xìng fú pīn mìng de gōng zuò
拼命.en: He worked hard to make his child happy.
拼命.es: Trabajó duro para hacer feliz a su hijo.

拼命.en: I ran as fast as I could.

拼命.zh: 这么拼命工作有什么意义？
拼命.pinyin: Zhè me pīn mìng gōng zuò yǒu shén me yì yì
拼命.en: What's the sense of working so hard?
拼命.es: ¿Cuál es el sentido de trabajar tan duro?

拼命.zh: 由于贫穷，他们不得不拼命工作。
拼命.pinyin: Yóu yú pín qióng tā men bù dé bù pīn mìng gōng zuò
拼命.en: Seeing as they're poor, they've no choice but to work their hardest.

风暴.pinyin: Fēng bào shì wēi xiǎn de

风暴.zh: 我们因为风暴推迟了起程。
风暴.pinyin: Wǒ men yīn wèi fēng bào tuī chí le qǐ chéng
风暴.en: We postponed our departure because of the storm.
风暴.es: Pospusimos nuestra salida a causa de la tormenta.

风暴.pinyin: Yīn wèi fēng bào tā men wǎn dào liǎo
风暴.en: They arrived late because of the storm.
风暴.es: Ellos llegaron tarde a causa de la tormenta.

风暴.zh: 一棵大树在风暴中倒下了。
风暴.pinyin: Yī kē dà shù zài fēng bào zhōng dǎo xià le
风暴.en: A big tree has fallen in the storm.
风暴.es: Un gran árbol fue tumbado por la tormenta.

实行.pinyin: Wǒ men shí xíng le nà ge jì huà

实行.zh: 若没你的帮助，我们大概无法实行这个计划吧。
实行.pinyin: Ruò méi nǐ de bāng zhù wǒ men dà gài wú fǎ shí xíng zhè ge jì huà ba
实行.en: I guess we wouldn't have been able to carry out the plan if it weren't for your help.
实行.es: Supongo que no hubiésemos podido llevar a cabo el plan de no ser por tu ayuda.

实行.zh: 谁也不能阻止这个计划的实行。
实行.pinyin: Shéi yě bù néng zǔ zhǐ zhè ge jì huà de shí xíng
实行.en: Nobody can prevent this plan from being carried out.
实行.es: Nadie puede impedir que este plan sea llevado a cabo.

实行.zh: 我意识到要实行这件事是很困难的。
实行.pinyin: Wǒ yì shí dào yào shí xíng zhè jiàn shì shì hěn kùn nan de
实行.en: I realized that putting this thing into practice was hard.

富裕.zh: 我更愿意贫穷而不是富裕。
富裕.pinyin: Wǒ gèng yuàn yì pín qióng ér bù shì fù yù
富裕.en: I prefer being poor to being rich.
富裕.es: Prefiero ser pobre a ser rico.

富裕.zh: 要不是当初有内战，他们现在应该挺富裕了。
富裕.pinyin: Yào bu shì dāng chū yǒu nèi zhàn tā men xiàn zài yīng gāi tǐng fù yù le
富裕.en: If it had not been for civil war, they would be wealthy now.
富裕.es: Si no hubiera sido por la guerra civil, ahora ellos serían ricos.

富裕.zh: 人们看待事情的角度不同取决於他们是富裕或贫穷。
富裕.pinyin: Rén men kàn dài shì qing de jiǎo dù bù tóng qǔ jué yú tā men shì fù yù huò pín qióng
富裕.en: People look at things differently depending on whether they are rich or poor.
富裕.es: Una persona ve las cosas de manera diferente dependiendo de si es rica o pobre.

富裕.zh: 玛丽不穷，相反，她相当富裕。
富裕.pinyin: Mǎ lì bù qióng xiāng fǎn tā xiāng dāng fù yù
富裕.en: Mary is not poor. On the contrary, she is quite rich.
富裕.es: Mary no es pobre. Al contrario, es bastante rica.

防止.zh: 律师是防止别人拿你的钱的人。
防止.pinyin: Lǜ shī shì fáng zhǐ bié ren ná nǐ de qián de rén
防止.en: A lawyer is a person who prevents someone else from getting your money.
防止.es: Un abogado es una persona que evita que alguien más obtenga tu dinero.

防止.pinyin: Fáng zhǐ shān huǒ rén rén yǒu zé
防止.en: The prevention of forest fires is everyone's responsibility.
防止.es: La prevención de los incendios forestales es responsabilidad de todos.

防止.zh: 您不能防止您的狗跑到我的院子里来吗？
防止.pinyin: Nín bù néng fáng zhǐ nín de gǒu páo dào wǒ de yuàn zi lǐ lái ma
防止.en: Can't you keep your dog from coming into my garden?

防止.zh: 为了防止盗版，他有些电影从未在影院上映。
防止.pinyin: Wèi le fáng zhǐ dào bǎn tā yǒu xiē diàn yǐng cóng wèi zài yǐng yuàn shàng yìng
防止.en: To prevent them from being pirated, some of his films were never shown at the cinema.

维持.zh: 和一个只说"是"与"否"的人维持一段对话是很难的。
维持.pinyin: Hé yī ge zhǐ shuō shì yǔ fǒu de rén wéi chí yī duàn duì huà shì hěn nán de
维持.en: It is difficult to keep up a conversation with someone who only says "yes" and "no".
维持.es: Es difícil mantener una conversación con alguien que sólo dice "sí" y "no".

维持.zh: 你在东京如何维持生计？
维持.pinyin: Nǐ zài dōng jīng rú hé wéi chí shēng jì
维持.en: How did you make a living in Tokyo?

维持.zh: 维持一个人的声誉是很难的。
维持.pinyin: Wéi chí yī gè rén de shēng yù shì hěn nán de
维持.en: It is hard to maintain one's reputation.

维持.zh: 许多网站都是靠广告收入来维持的。
维持.pinyin: Xǔ duō wǎng zhàn dōu shì kào guǎng gào shōu rù lái wéi chí de
维持.en: Many websites are supported by revenue from advertising.

消耗.zh: 我们消耗了所有的自然资源。
消耗.pinyin: Wǒ men xiāo hào le suǒ yǒu de zì rán zī yuán
消耗.en: We have consumed all the natural resources.
消耗.es: Hemos consumido todos los recursos naturales.

消耗.pinyin: Ruì shì rén xiāo hào bù shǎo pí jiǔ
消耗.en: The Swiss consume a large amount of beer.

消耗.zh: 农业需要消耗大量的水。
消耗.pinyin: Nóng yè xū yào xiāo hào dà liàng de shuǐ
消耗.en: Agriculture consumes a great amount of water.

消耗.zh: 这座巧克力工厂每一天消耗二十公吨可可原料。
消耗.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiǎo kè lì gōng chǎng měi yī tiān xiāo hào èr shí gōng dūn kě kě yuán liào
消耗.en: This chocolate factory consumes twenty metric tons of raw cocoa per day.

攀登.zh: 攀登富士山后，我得到了一首诗的灵感。
攀登.pinyin: Pān dēng fù shì shān hòu wǒ dé dào le yī shǒu shī de líng gǎn
攀登.en: After climbing Mt. Fuji, I got the inspiration for a poem.

攀登.zh: 他是第一个在冬季攀登富士山的人。
攀登.pinyin: Tā shì dì yī gè zài dōng jì pān dēng fù shì shān de rén
攀登.en: He was the first man to climb Mt. Fuji in the winter.

攀登.pinyin: Wǒ men xiǎng pān dēng fù shì shān
攀登.en: We want to climb Mt. Fuji.

攀登.zh: 他们放弃了攀登富士山的计画。
攀登.pinyin: Tā men fàng qì le pān dēng fù shì shān de jì huà
攀登.en: They gave up their plan to climb Mt. Fuji.

障碍.zh: 汤姆认为玛丽可能有进食障碍。
障碍.pinyin: Tāng mǔ rèn wéi mǎ lì kě néng yǒu jìn shí zhàng ài
障碍.en: Tom thinks that Mary may have an eating disorder.
障碍.es: Tom piensa que quizá María tenga un desorden alimenticio.

障碍.zh: 汤姆是他们最大的障碍。
障碍.pinyin: Tāng mǔ shì tā men zuì dà de zhàng ài
障碍.en: Tom was the biggest obstacle for them.

障碍.zh: 没有愿望是最大的障碍。
障碍.pinyin: Méi yǒu yuàn wàng shì zuì dà de zhàng ài
障碍.en: Having no will is the worst handicap.

障碍.zh: 哪些原因可能导致男性高潮障碍？
障碍.pinyin: Nǎ xiē yuán yīn kě néng dǎo zhì nán xìng gāo cháo zhàng ài
障碍.en: What can cause orgasm problems in men?

预料.pinyin: Tāng mǔ yù liào zhè huì fā shēng
Wǒ yù liào huì yǒu má fan
预料.en: I anticipate that there will be trouble.

预料.zh: 它现代化的程度远远超乎我的预料。
预料.pinyin: Tā xiàn dài huà de chéng dù yuǎn yuǎn chāo hū wǒ de yù liào
预料.en: Its modernization was far beyond my expectations.

预料.zh: 正如玛莉所预料的一样，汤姆迟到了。
预料.pinyin: Zhèng rú mǎ lì suǒ yù liào de yī yàng tāng mǔ chí dào le
预料.en: Tom was late, just like Mary predicted.

储备.zh: 面粉是那些你始终应该储备在厨房里的产品之一。
储备.pinyin: Miàn fěn shì nà xiē nǐ shǐ zhōng yīng gāi chǔ bèi zài chú fáng lǐ de chǎn pǐn zhī yī
储备.en: Flour is one of those products you should always have in your kitchen.

出神.zh: 如果世界上没有神，那么我就用双手创造出神。
出神.pinyin: Rú guǒ shì jiè shàng méi yǒu shén nà me wǒ jiù yòng shuāng shǒu chuàng zào chū shén
出神.en: If God doesn't exist in our world, then I will create God with my own hands.
出神.es: Si Dios no existe en nuestro mundo, entonces crearé a Dios con mis propias manos.

出神.zh: 汤姆出神地一边看着天空一边吸着香烟。
出神.pinyin: Tāng mǔ chū shén de yī biān kàn zhe tiān kōng yī biān xī zhuó xiāng yān
出神.en: Lost in thought, Tom watched the sky as he smoked a cigarette.
出神.es: Tom miraba el cielo perdido en sus pensamientos mientras se fumaba un cigarro.

首饰.zh: 先生小姐，你们买点什么首饰？
首饰.pinyin: Xiān sheng xiǎo jie nǐ men mǎi diǎn shén me shǒu shì

饭馆儿.zh: 那家饭馆儿的服务员给我们留下很好的印象。

饭馆儿.zh: 那个饭馆儿在火车站前面。

人满为患.zh: 昨天这家商店正好人满为患。

其一.zh: 林肯的父母终其一生都很穷。

其一.en: Lincoln's parents remained poor all their lives.
其一.es: Los padres de Lincoln fueron pobres toda la vida.

其所.zh: 汤姆尽其所能地帮助玛丽。

其所.en: Tom did what he could to help Mary.

冬日.zh: 寒冷乾燥，灿烂的阳光，多么美丽的冬日天气!

土生土长.zh: 熊猫在四川省土生土长，不在任何其他省份的野外生活。

Tā shì gè tōng qíng dá lǐ de rén
